heroEyebrow: Private music lessons for every age
heroTitle: Find your sound. Build your confidence.
heroText: Personal lessons with working musicians who make progress feel exciting, practical, and entirely your own.
aboutText: Whether this is your first note or your next big audition, we meet you where you are. Our instructors combine thoughtful structure with the freedom to explore the music you genuinely love.
contactText: Tell us a little about the student, their interests, and your schedule. We’ll follow up with a personal recommendation.
